profile.Civilian Name: Diana Ardent (English Identity); Minamoto no Akiko 源 明子 (Japan Identity)
profile.Date of Birth: 12 August 1022 CE (peak of the Perseid meteor shower)
profile.Languages: Japanese, English; other languages acquired throughout her lifetime
profile.Education: Extensive knowledge accumulated through centuries of Guardian service, independent study, and practical experience.
profile.Civilian Appearance: Diana is a tall woman with a strong, athletic build and a commanding presence. She has long, dark hair with subtle golden-brown highlights, amber eyes, and elegant facial features. Although she appears to be in her mid-forties, her movements remain remarkably youthful. She prefers sophisticated but practical clothing, often choosing tailored outfits with subtle gold accessories.
profile.Guardian Appearance: Leo has long, flowing golden hair, brilliant amber eyes, and an imposing appearance inspired by a celestial lioness. Her Guardian outfit has a white and gold base, with decorative armour along her shoulders, arms, and legs. A flowing golden cape resembles a lion's mane when illuminated by her magic. Her transformation emphasises physical strength, elegance, and authority.
profile.Signature Ability:
- Lionheart: Leo reinforces her physical strength, speed, and durability using concentrated Fire magic. Her close-range attacks carry tremendous force, allowing her to overwhelm heavily armoured enemies.
- Solar Claw: Channels golden flames around her hands and feet, producing claw-shaped strikes capable of tearing through magical defences.
- Lion's Roar: Releases a powerful wave of Fire magic from her body, pushing enemies away and creating space to protect nearby allies.
profile.Strengths: Exceptional physical strength, close-range combat, endurance, courage, leadership, combat instincts, discipline, adaptability, and centuries of experience.
profile.Weaknesses: Leo's direct combat style can make her less effective against enemies who specialise in keeping their distance. Her pride and confidence occasionally cause her to underestimate opponents or attempt to resolve difficult situations through personal strength.
profile.Fear: Losing the disciples she has raised and trained, particularly after becoming emotionally attached to them over the centuries.
profile.Disciple: Luma Lumen, Luma Umbra, Luma Valour
profile.Close bonds: Luma Lumen, Luma Umbra, Luma Valour, the original Zodiacs
profile.Loves: watching younger Guardians grow stronger, peaceful days, traditional Japanese culture, and seeing the people she protects live fulfilling lives.
profile.Likes: Martial arts, physical training, direct communication, honesty, friendly competitions, tea, and revisiting places from her past.
profile.Dislikes: Cowardice disguised as arrogance, unnecessary bureaucracy, reckless behaviour, dishonesty, and people who refuse to acknowledge their mistakes.
profile.Hates: Cruelty towards innocent people, exploitation of the weak, betrayal, and using power to oppress others.
profile.Hobbies: Martial arts practice, gardening, travelling, reading historical literature, traditional Japanese arts, and occasionally visiting her former disciples.
profile.Personality:
Leo is confident, courageous, disciplined, and naturally authoritative, with a mischievous streak that becomes particularly obvious around her disciples. Although she is a respected original Zodiac, she takes great amusement in putting her disciples through unexpected challenges, especially those designed to test their reaction time, awareness, and adaptability.
As a mentor, Leo can be strict and demanding, expecting her disciples to give their best effort without pushing themselves recklessly beyond their limits. Although she rarely expresses affection openly, she takes considerable pride in their achievements.
She frequently launches harmless surprise attacks, throws unexpected objects, or creates sudden obstacles to see how quickly her disciples respond. She considers these exercises essential survival training, although her disciples often accuse her of inventing excuses to torment them.
Despite her teasing, Leo is a highly capable and responsible mentor who never intentionally places her disciples in genuine danger. She knows their limits remarkably well and adjusts her exercises accordingly. Her methods can be frustrating, but they have produced exceptionally alert and adaptable Guardians.
Even after retirement, Leo occasionally continues these habits whenever she visits her former disciples. To her, becoming a Full-Fledged Guardian does not mean someone has graduated from reaction-time training.
Personality Examples
- When Lumen accomplishes something remarkable, Leo gives her a proud smile and says, "Well done." Only those who know her understand how much that simple praise means.
- When Valour visits, Leo appears from behind a doorway and throws a training ball towards him. He catches it, pauses, and asks, "Are we seriously still doing this?" Leo responds, "Your reaction time has slowed."
profile.Core Idea of character: A proud lioness who once stood at the forefront of humanity's defence and later entrusted that responsibility to the Guardians she raised.
Quotes: "Strength means nothing if you only use it to prove yourself."

As one of the first Guardians, Leo participated in humanity's early struggles against hostile magical creatures. Her exceptional physical strength, combat instincts, and leadership eventually made her one of the most respected combatants among the original Zodiacs.
